---
title: "wrapped fixture: fig-column body over column classes"
filters:
  - wrapped
fig-column: body
column: page
format:
  pdf:
    keep-tex: true
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    fig-format: png
---

With `fig-column: body` and `column: page` in the document, Quarto reads a
float's own `fig-column-*` class first, then the document's `fig-column`.
So in PDF a float with its own `column-*` class sits in the body, and a
float with its own `fig-column-margin` class sits in the margin.
